title: P1: Closed automation history disappears from ordinary search
detail: When all automation runs are closed, the Automations selectors disappear and a harvested run cannot be found by exact ID with is:any from All, even though the daemon sends it. An explicit bed:automations query finds it. A native probe and independent review reproduced this on both keymaps. Evidence: s-ma3jmt/garden-display-review.md.
